comments.text:
If this journey changed the way you see Indonesia, there’s another story waiting for you. Watch the next documentary here:
👉Living in Tokelau | How Life Works Where the Catch Is Shared Across the Village:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WsDmTmc6UNg
👉 *Living in Indonesia | How Life Works Beneath Active Volcanoes* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PShTz4re5rI
👉Living in Saba | How Life Works on an Island with Almost No Flat Land:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OMnM1kYyvNk
👉Living in Palmerston | How Life Works on an Island with Only 30 People:   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wtCSJtL3bg4

I knew Indonesia had volcanoes and thousands of islands, but I never realized how much everyday life depends on ferries, ports, and supply routes. What surprised you more—the volcanic risks or how people keep everything moving across the islands?
